# Oladipo Ajibawo

> Senior Project Manager for IT and cybersecurity programmes, based in England, UK, with 12+ years delivering IT infrastructure, telecoms, energy and digital transformation programmes in the UK and Nigeria. PMP, PRINCE2 7 Practitioner, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Auditor, MSc Cyber Security (Distinction, University of Derby). Open to senior project and programme roles in IT and cybersecurity.

- Project Manager, Mcjay Recruitment Consultancy (London, Apr 2025 to present): healthcare recruitment pipeline and NHS staffing programme delivery

- PMO and Network Analyst, American Tower Corporation (Lagos, Mar 2017 to Oct 2021): national PMO for 1,500+ tower upgrades, Power BI portfolio reporting
- IT Project Manager, Scenic International Group (remote, Jun 2014 to Dec 2016): NetSuite ERP, Boomi, Azure and Microsoft 365 delivery
